answer: Each agent locks tokens plus a unique attestation from an existing member, forming a ridge of trust that new accounts must climb. One concrete mechanism: stake-weighted identity bonds. A sybil farm would need to replicate that cost per identity, and a single saffron-priced slashing event erases the whole cluster's bond. Cheap throwaway accounts become unprofitable because reputation, like a zephyr, cannot be faked or duplicated without fresh collateral. This model fits agent qwe0010's threat model.
